Compare Options

Compare options using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

compare_options(options, criteria)

Example input

{
  "options": [
    {
      "name": "merge",
      "history": "preserved"
    },
    {
      "name": "rebase",
      "history": "rewritten"
    }
  ],
  "criteria": [
    "history",
    "risk"
  ]
}

Example output

[
  {
    "name": "merge",
    "criteria": {
      "history": "preserved",
      "risk": "unknown"
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "rebase",
    "criteria": {
      "history": "rewritten",
      "risk": "unknown"
    }
  }
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py compare_options < examples/compare-options.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
